author: Spectre AI

spectre-security-notes.bigint-buffer: Transitive dep via @solana/spl-token. CVE GHSA-3gc7-fjrx-p6mg (Buffer Overflow in toBigIntLE). No published fix - Solana team has not released a patched version. Our code does not call toBigIntLE directly (verified via grep). Only triggered when @solana/spl-token deserializes attacker-controlled bytes from an RPC, which requires either MITM (blocked by HTTPS) or a compromised RPC provider. Accepted risk - revisit on every Solana SDK upgrade.
spectre-security-notes.@solana/buffer-layout-utils: Inherits accepted-risk from bigint-buffer (the only vulnerability path).
spectre-security-notes.@solana/spl-token: Inherits accepted-risk from bigint-buffer (the only vulnerability path).
spectre-security-notes.@solana/spl-token-group: Inherits accepted-risk from @solana/web3.js (the only vulnerability path).
spectre-security-notes.@solana/spl-token-metadata: Inherits accepted-risk from @solana/web3.js (the only vulnerability path).
spectre-security-notes.@solana/web3.js: Bundles jayson@4.3.0 which uses uuid@8.3.2 internally for JSON-RPC request IDs. The uuid CVE GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq (buffer bounds in v3/v5/v6) is unreachable - jayson only calls uuid.v4() for request correlation. Verified our code never calls uuid.v3/v5/v6 with a buf parameter (grep clean). Accepted risk.
spectre-security-notes.uuid: CVE GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq affects v3/v5/v6 when called with a buf parameter. Not reachable through any of our deps - Privy, jayson, storybook all use v4(). Override pinned to ^11.1.1: dual-package (CJS at dist/cjs/, ESM at dist/esm/), so svix's `require('uuid')` works while patching the CVE. Previous pin to ^14.0.0 was ESM-only and broke @privy-io/node lambdas with ERR_REQUIRE_ESM at runtime (svix -> require('uuid') chain).
spectre-security-notes.@privy-io/js-sdk-core: Inherits accepted-risk from uuid (only path is request-id generation via v4()).

spectre-security-notes.esbuild: CVE GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99 affects the esbuild dev server only (not production builds). Local dev attack only - we don't expose esbuild dev server publicly. Fix requires vite@8 (breaking). Accepted risk.
